evidenceKind: Targeted static PE inspection with ordinary LLVM objdump and Pascal/ERM source reads; not REA native Evidence. No execution was performed for this investigation.

operations: Read AR:V into n; only replace piles with2<=n<=9.
For wood,ore,gold: n=integer-truncation(n/2)+1. Other resource types keep n.
Recreate resource pile as mithril, then write AR:V=n.
For campfires: FR:B?r/?n followed by B(RES_MITHRIL)/n, preserving n.

binaryObservations.name: AR receiver object guard
binaryObservations.observation: Object type checked against79(resource),5(artifact),93(scroll); raw object-setup DWORD selected.

binaryObservations.name: AR:V raw amount read/write branch
binaryObservations.observation: V dispatch reads setupDWORD&0x7ffff, passes this integer to ZvsApply without checking resource subtype or scaling. On a simple setter, it writes a zero-extended16-bit local into low19bits and preserves high13bits. Getter exits before this rewrite when ZvsApply reports GET. Large setters are outside option170 range.

binaryObservations.name: Resource pickup quantity and gold multiplier
binaryObservations.observation: Read raw quantity from low19bits. Read resource subtype at object+0x22. If subtype=6(gold), multiply raw quantity by100; otherwise retain it.

binaryObservations.name: Resource pickup reward call1
binaryObservations.observation: Pass calculated quantity and resource subtype to the grant primitive at0x4e3870.

binaryObservations.name: Resource pickup reward call2
binaryObservations.observation: Alternative collection path passes the same calculated quantity and subtype to0x4e3870.

binaryObservations.name: FR:B packed resource and amount
binaryObservations.observation: B dispatch: resource type is low4bits; amount is setupDWORD>>4 (28-bit field). Both are passed to ZvsApply separately. Type write preserves the amount; quantity write preserves the type. Setter local is zero-extended16bit before repacking; outside normal small quantities, this is a legacy limitation.

binaryObservations.name: Campfire pickup decode and both rewards
binaryObservations.observation: Read selected type from low4bits and quantity from the signed low16bits of setupDWORD>>4. Unconditionally pass100*quantity and resource6(gold) to0x4e3870, then quantity and selected resource type to the same primitive.

binaryObservations.name: Original resource-grant primitive validation
binaryObservations.observation: On-disk primitive accepts resource IDs0..6, reads player amount and adds the requested quantity. Actual mithril ID7 grants require additional WoG behavior not followed here.

eraSourceCrossCheck.observation: ERA hooks ZvsApply at0x74195d. Hook_ZvsApply implements GET via SetErmParamValue and plain SET via PutVal, with no resource-specific multiplier. A bounded search of supplied Erm/AdvErm/GameExt/Tweaks source found no separate AR/FR receiver replacement or direct patch of the examined AR/FR instruction addresses; this is not exhaustive dynamic patch discovery.

conclusions.resourcePileUnits: AR:V exposes internal count units, not the final displayed/credited gold amount. Gold countn yields100*n gold; wood,ore and ordinary non-gold quantities use n directly. AR:V itself performs no division-by100 or gold-specific rounding.
conclusions.option170Gold: A gold pile with raw AR:V5 (500gold at pickup) becomes floor(5/2)+1=3mithril; testing the full gold amount500 against2..9 would be wrong.
conclusions.option170Truncation: For source option170, integer division by2 truncates positive odd counts:2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 map to2,2,3,3,4,4,5,5. These small setters suffer no16-bit loss.
conclusions.campfireGoldConservation: FR:B changes only selected non-gold type and keeps quantityn. The campfire gold component is calculated separately as100*n, so its formula and amount remain intact when the selected type changes to mithril. n5 remains500gold plus5 units of the selected resource, subject to WoG handling of mithril.

limits: Static observations and derived examples only; no pile or campfire collection was executed. No new game instance or container was started.
Observed instruction ranges describe supplied on-disk EXE. Generic ERA ZvsApply hook was checked in matching supplied source, not dynamically inspected after every mod/plugin patch.
Effective mithril-grant interception and UI labels are not established by this bounded analysis. In particular, the original grant primitive still validates IDs0..6.
Map-file import conversion from arbitrary non-multiple-of100 gold values was not investigated; AR:V reads an already packed internal count.
Large/negative AR:V and FR:B setter behavior, signed16bit campfire overflow and unrelated receivers are outside option170 scope.
No original Windows executable bytes or disassembly text are included in this report.
